args.title: Warehouse returns tote operation
args.description: Open the tote lid, place a carton and a shrink-wrapped pack inside, then close the lid.

steps.description: Hook the lid's lip and pull it open.
Pick the carton from the bench and place it in the tote.
Pick the shrink-wrapped pack from the bench and place it in the tote.
Push the lid shut until it closes.

assumptions: The tote lid behaves as a lid opening upward with a lip for hooking.
The carton dimensions are 120x80x60 mm and mass 300 g.
The shrink-wrapped pack dimensions are 150x100x20 mm and mass 150 g.
The tote bin height is 120 mm to match the lid hinge height.

args.title: Pipe coupling installation
args.description: Push a threaded coupling onto a pipe stub and turn it clockwise until snug, keeping torque below 8 N m.

steps.description: Push the coupling onto the thread start.
Turn the coupling clockwise until snug, not exceeding 8 N m.

assumptions: Thread pitch is 1.5 mm typical for 1‑inch pipe coupling.
Coupling mass is small enough to ignore inertial effects.

insert_coupling: Threads are an approximation: a helical joint with a torque ramp; no thread flanks, cross-threading or galling. A screen, not a promise.
tighten_coupling: Threads are an approximation: a helical joint with a torque ramp; no thread flanks, cross-threading or galling. A screen, not a promise.

args.title: Cabinet maintenance
args.description: Unlock the quarter-turn latch, swing the cabinet door open, open the handwheel valve by a quarter turn, then insert the test plug into the service port.

steps.description: Turn the quarter-turn latch counter‑clockwise to unlock it.
Hook the door handle and pull the door open.
Turn the handwheel valve counter‑clockwise a quarter turn to open it.
Insert the test plug into the service port until seated.

assumptions: The latch requires about 0.8 N·m to overcome its detent.
The door hinge resists opening with 0.3 N·m torque.
The valve needs roughly 3 N·m to turn against its resistive torque.
The plug insertion faces ~5 N friction force.

unlatch: Latches are an approximation: a detent torque on a revolute joint; no cam or spring geometry.
open_valve: Valves are an approximation: a resistive torque curve on a revolute joint; no packing or seat dynamics.

args.title: Plant maintenance round
args.description: Open the hatch of a valve box, turn the isolation valve handwheel one full turn counter-clockwise, then close the hatch.

steps.description: Hook the hatch handle and pull to open the hatch.
Turn the handwheel counter‑clockwise one full turn.
Push the hatch lid to close it.

assumptions: The hatch is a lid approx 400 × 300 mm with a handle lip 20 mm from the edge.
The valve handwheel has 150 mm diameter rim and provides ~4 Nm resistive torque over one turn.

open_valve: Valves are an approximation: a resistive torque curve on a revolute joint; no packing or seat dynamics.
